be senior to: Although Amy is younger, she is senior to me at the company because she joined it earlier.
雖然艾咪比較年輕，但她在公司的職位高於我，因為她比較早進公司。
senior citizens: Senior citizens can take the MRT at a discount in Taipei, so many grandparents travel by train.
在台北，銀髮族搭捷運可以享有優惠，所以許多爺爺奶奶都搭捷運出門。
senior management: The plan must be approved by senior management before we can start hiring new workers.
這個計畫必須經過高階管理層批准，我們才能開始招募新員工。
senior high school: After graduating from junior high, my cousin went to a senior high school near Taichung Station.
國中畢業後，我表哥進了台中車站附近的一所高中。
a senior official: A senior official from the Ministry of Education visited our school to discuss the new curriculum.
一位教育部的高級官員來我們學校討論新課綱。
the senior partner: As the senior partner of the law firm, Mr. Lin makes the final decision on every big case.
身為這家律師事務所的資深合夥人，林先生對每一件大案子做最後的決定。
a sensible decision: Taking an umbrella was a sensible decision, because it started raining heavily soon after we left.
帶傘是個明智的決定，因為我們出門後不久就開始下大雨。
sensible shoes: Wear sensible shoes on the hiking trip, because the mountain paths are rocky and slippery.
健行時要穿實穿的鞋，因為山路多石又濕滑。
be sensible of: The new manager was sensible of the difficulties his team faced and offered them extra help.
新經理察覺到他的團隊面臨的困難，並提供他們額外的協助。
a sensible precaution: Locking your bike is a sensible precaution, even if you only leave it outside for a minute.
把腳踏車上鎖是合理的預防措施，即使你只把它留在外面一分鐘也一樣。
sentimental value: This old watch isn't expensive, but it has great sentimental value because it belonged to my grandfather.
這支舊手錶並不貴，但它有很大的情感上的價值，因為它曾屬於我爺爺。
a sentimental journey: Fifty years later, Grandma made a sentimental journey back to the village where she grew up.
五十年後，奶奶踏上一趟感傷之旅，回到她長大的村莊。
get sentimental: My mom always gets sentimental and cries a little when she looks at our old baby photos.
我媽媽看我們小時候的照片時，總是變得多愁善感，還會掉一點眼淚。
a sentimental attachment: Even after twenty years, Dad still has a strong sentimental attachment to the house where he grew up.
即使過了二十年，爸爸對他長大的房子仍有強烈的情感上的依戀。
severe weather: Because of severe weather, including strong winds and heavy rain, all flights to Kinmen were cancelled.
由於強風豪雨等嚴峻的天氣，所有飛往金門的班機都取消了。
a severe shortage: The hospital is facing a severe shortage of nurses, so the doctors must work longer hours.
這家醫院面臨護理師嚴重短缺，所以醫生們必須工作更長的時間。
severe punishment: Cheating on the exam will lead to severe punishment, such as failing the course or being suspended.
考試作弊會受到嚴厲的懲罰，例如該科被當或被停學。
a severe test: The long, hot marathon was a severe test of the runners' strength and patience.
這場又長又熱的馬拉松對跑者的體力和耐心是一場嚴苛的考驗。
a severe blow: Losing their best player to injury was a severe blow to the team's hopes of winning the title.
最好的球員因傷缺陣，對球隊奪冠的希望是沉重的打擊。
severe criticism: The government faced severe criticism after it failed to respond quickly to the flood.
政府在未能迅速應對水災後，遭到嚴厲的批評。
a severe expression: The principal looked at us with a severe expression, and we knew we were in serious trouble.
校長帶著嚴肅的表情看著我們，我們就知道自己麻煩大了。
a shady deal: The police discovered that the mayor had made a shady deal with a construction company.
警方發現市長和一家建設公司做了不正當的交易。
a shady character: A shady character in a dark hoodie kept watching the shop, so the owner called the police.
一個穿著深色連帽衫的可疑的人物一直盯著店裡看，所以老闆報了警。
shady business: He got rich very quickly, and his neighbors suspected he was involved in some shady business.
他很快就致富了，鄰居們懷疑他涉入了某些見不得光的生意。
a shady spot: The sun was burning hot, so we looked for a shady spot under the trees where the sunlight couldn't reach us.
太陽熱得發燙，所以我們在樹下找了一個陽光照不到的陰涼處。
a shallow argument: His essay made only a shallow argument, with no evidence or deep thinking to support his main idea.
他的文章只提出了膚淺的論點，沒有證據或深入的思考來支持他的主要觀點。
a shallow person: She is such a shallow person that she only cares about clothes, money, and how people look.
她是個非常膚淺的人，只在乎衣服、錢和別人的外表。
shallow breathing: Anxiety can cause fast, shallow breathing, so try to take slow, deep breaths when you feel nervous.
焦慮會造成又快又淺的淺呼吸，所以緊張時試著慢慢地深呼吸。
the shallow end: Children who cannot swim well should stay in the shallow end of the pool, where the water is only one meter deep.
不太會游泳的孩子應該待在泳池的淺水區，那裡的水只有一公尺深。
a shallow understanding: If you only memorize answers, you'll have a shallow understanding of math and forget it after the test.
如果你只背答案，你對數學只會有淺薄的理解，考完試就忘了。
